transcript.t: My best friend is Mike. We met in Grade 6 and have been friends for two years.
We are not alike in many ways. Mike is tall and loves sports, but I am short and prefer art.
He is always on time, but I am sometimes late. He is honest and direct, and he tells me the truth.
Still, we have a lot in common. We both love science fiction and we both enjoy hot pot.
Last week I made a mistake in a test, and I felt sad. Mike lent me a hand and explained the problem.
A good friend is like a mirror. He helps me see myself better.
